content_sections.heading: About IIIT Sri City
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City, Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, describes itself as a Research and Teaching Institute focused on Computer Science, Electronics and Communications, and their applications in other domains. It is an Institution of National Importance set up by the Government of India (MHRD), the Government of Andhra Pradesh and Industry Partners (represented by Sri City Foundation) as a not-for-profit Public Private Partnership (N-PPP) Society. The JRF post is in a project taken up under administrative approval No. DS-2B-13012(2)/32/2026-Sec.2 from SDSR-SHAR, ISRO, dated 22 October 2026. The project works with data from the Multi Object Tracking Radar (MOTR), an L-Band Active Phased Array Radar that has tracked and catalogued nearly 54 space objects at altitudes of 400 to 900 km. The received signal is studied to find a debris object's dynamics, spin, size and RCS, so that the debris can be catalogued and its drag coefficient and lifetime worked out.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need both of the following: B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and communication/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above, and M.Tech./M.E. in RF and Microwave Engineering/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above. SC/ST/PwD applicants get a 5% relaxation in the marks for each of these qualifications. NET/GATE/national level examinations conducted by the Central Govt and their agencies etc. This is listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one. Strong knowledge in electromagnetics fundamentals Fundamentals of radar, Types of Radars, working principles of Tracking Radars Radar cross section, theoretical models to compute RCS Basis understanding of space debris, size estimation models, free space wave propagation, and Good hands on using MATLAB/Python Strong knowledge in Antenna concepts Working experience EM simulation tools Good understanding of ML models The preference may be given to candidates who have published papers in reputed Journals/Conferences (paid journals are not considered) The Institute may relax the qualification and experience at any time for exceptional candidates. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is set by the funding agency norm: Rs. 37000 + 10% HRA for a JRF. The notice states that no other allowances are admissible. The project duration is 18 months. The position is purely temporary, and the candidate's association with the institute ends automatically on the closing date of the project. Either the PI of the project or the candidate can end the association at any time with one month's notice in writing. Progress is monitored continuously, and the JRF may be asked to leave if performance is unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Sri City Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Applications go only through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/wrZNzBnwpLSv7irk6, by 1 November 2026. Applications sent by email are not accepted. Open the application form at https://forms.gle/wrZNzBnwpLSv7irk6. Give a valid email ID, because the institute informs shortlisted candidates of the interview date by email. Upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae that describes your working knowledge in line with the requirements in the notification. Upload soft copies of your mark sheets and certificates. Send questions about the application process to [email protected] (PI of the project). Detailed Curriculum Vitae Soft copies of Mark Sheets Soft copies of Certificates A "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, for applicants in government/semi-government employment

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting is based on the needs of the project. Meeting the prescribed qualification does not guarantee a call for interview. Only shortlisted candidates are told the interview date, by email. The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time and to consider candidates with exceptional credentials who have not applied. Selected candidates must be able to report to the institute immediately.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Sri City JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIIT Sri City has 01 (One) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the MOTR space debris research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Sri City JRF post?
faq.answer: The closing date is 1 November 2026. Applications opened on 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIIT Sri City JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and communication/Equivalent and an M.Tech./M.E. in RF and Microwave Engineering/Equivalent, each with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a relaxation in the qualifying marks for SC/ST/PwD candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST/PwD applicants get a 5% relaxation in the 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) required in both the B.Tech./B.E. and the M.Tech./M.E.

faq.question: Q5. Is NET or GATE compulsory for the IIIT Sri City JRF post?
faq.answer: No. NET/GATE/national level examinations conducted by the Central Govt and their agencies are listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the IIIT Sri City JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37000 + 10% HRA, as per the funding agency norm for a JRF.

faq.question: Q7. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: 10% HRA is paid on top of the Rs. 37000 fellowship. The notice states that no other allowances are admissible.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the IIIT Sri City JRF post?
faq.answer: Apply only through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/wrZNzBnwpLSv7irk6 and upload a detailed CV along with soft copies of your mark sheets and certificates. Applications sent by email are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IIIT Sri City JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on the needs of the project, and only shortlisted candidates are emailed the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIIT Sri City JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for the 18-month project, and the association ends automatically on the closing date of the project.
